result.paraphrase: ADATA XPG SX6000 Lite 512GB SSD, PCIe Gen3x4 M.2 2280 QLC, with read/write speeds of 1800/1200 MB/s. Description: XPG SX6000 Lite PCIe Gen3x4 M.2 2280 solid-state drive. If you’re upgrading from a SATA SSD, the SX6000 Lite PCIe Gen3x4 M.2 2280 SSD is a strong choice. It supports NVMe 1.3, uses 3D NAND flash, and is available in capacities up to 1TB. Features include an ultra-fast PCIe Gen3x4 interface with R/W speeds up to 1800/1200 MB/s, NVMe 1.3 support, 3D NAND Flash for greater capacity and durability, advanced LDPC ECC technology, HMB (Host Memory Buffer), and SLC caching. Its compact M.2 2280 size makes it suitable for high-end desktops, notebooks, and Ultrabooks. Technical specifications: 512GB capacity, M.2 2280 form factor, 3D TLC NAND flash, dimensions 22 x 80 x 3.5 mm, weight 8 g, PCIe Gen3x4 interface, 0.33W typical active consumption, Realtek controller, 0.14W typical idle consumption, operating temperature 0°C~70°C, storage temperature -40°C~85°C, 1500G/0.5ms shock resistance, MTBF 2,000,000 hours, RoHS/CE/FCC/BSMI/VCCI/KC certifications, 5-year warranty.
